## Checklist

- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .` passes
- [ ] `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos` reports no new warnings or errors
- [ ] `flutter test` passes
- [ ] I tested on a physical Android device (or this change can't affect runtime behaviour)
- [ ] I updated the docs if this changes setup, behaviour, or the platform-channel contract
- [ ] I did **not** add a new dependency (or I opened an issue to discuss it first)
- [ ] No API keys, keystores, or `key.properties` are included in this PR
